description: Appoints members to four advisory subcommittees for 2025.

chips.text: Chair requested members commit to at least one subcommittee.

description: Sets 2025 diversity and inclusion budget at $15,100.
Allocates $11,000 for education and awareness sponsorships.
Approved $1,000 for Pleasant Hill, $500 for Sip of Culture.

chips.text: City staff confirmed underspending has not led to reduced future funding.
Committee members questioned the balance of funding amounts versus number of sponsorships.
Funding supports diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives for smaller groups.
Committee committed to maximizing the $15,100 budget for community initiatives.

segments.title: 2025 Budget Distribution Approval
segments.takeaway: The committee discussed and approved the distribution of the $50,100 budget for 2025, maintaining current allocations with flexibility for future reallocation.

segments.title: Sponsorship Requests Introduction
segments.takeaway: The committee began discussing specific sponsorship requests from the education and awareness budget line, as the subcommittee was not present to provide recommendations.

segments.title: Pleasant Hill Wrap Opera Sponsorship
segments.takeaway: The committee approved a $1,000 sponsorship for the Walker-Towend project's Pleasant Hill Wrap Opera, noting the event is scheduled for June 2025.

segments.title: Deferral of Sponsorship Request 10.2
segments.takeaway: The committee voted to defer discussion and decision on sponsorship request 10.2 to the February meeting due to time constraints and the event's later date.

segments.title: Sip of Culture Event Sponsorship
segments.takeaway: The committee approved a $500 sponsorship for the Amal Club's Sip of Culture event, advising them to also seek funding from university sources for future events.
